tasks.old_behavior: When the --clustered option is used without VG arguments and without --yes, vgchange prompts the user with the text 'Change clustered property of all volumes groups? [y/n]: ' (note the incorrect plural 'volumes groups').
tasks.new_behavior: After the patch, the prompt text reads 'Change clustered property of all volume groups? [y/n]: ' (corrected to 'volume groups'). The rest of the behavior is identical.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The user-visible prompt text has changed by one word ('volumes' -> 'volume'). This is a grammar fix that corrects the prompt string. Any test or automation that asserts on the exact prompt text 'volumes groups' would fail, though such tests are extremely unlikely given this is an interactive yes_no_prompt typically bypassed via --yes.
tasks.test_recommendation: Low-priority test: verify the corrected prompt text appears when running 'vgchange --clustered' without --yes and providing 'n' as input. Test via piping 'n' to the command and capturing stderr/stdout for the expected string.

strategy.preferred_artifact: single command line or regression test in the project's CLI test framework
strategy.trigger_surface: run the command/option combination that exercises the changed behavior
strategy.required_observation: byte-level stdout/stderr or parsed structured-output schema
